headline: Sensex and Nifty Crash on Manic Monday as Investors Lose Billions Amid Rising Oil Prices and Rate Hike Fears

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Fears of potential interest rate hikes
Heavy selling in private banking and IT sectors
Global cues and bond yield fluctuations
whatHappening: Sensex crashed nearly 1,000 points while Nifty dropped significantly
Investors lost up to ₹5 lakh crore in market wealth during the session
L&T Tech reported a 54% surge in quarterly profit despite market conditions
UltraTech Cement's net profit rose 21.3% to ₹1,501 crore
summary: Indian markets witnessed a sharp sell-off on Monday, with the Sensex plunging nearly 1,000 points due to rising oil prices and global concerns. While major indices bled, some companies like L&T Tech and UltraTech Cement reported positive earnings results. Banking and IT stocks were the primary laggards in today's session.
